ios.desc:
Intriq remembers the people you meet. Type a quick note or record the conversation, and Intriq pulls out the names, work updates, family details and follow-ups. You review them, and they live on each person’s profile. Before your next coffee, call or pitch, see everything you know in one place.

We meet people all the time: clients, investors, partners, candidates, colleagues, friends, and acquaintances. The problem is not that we lose their contact details. The problem is that we lose the context.

Who just moved roles?
Who mentioned their child’s birthday?
Who should you follow up with next month?
Who introduced you to whom?
What did you last speak about?

Intriq helps you remember the human details behind your network.

Write quick, natural notes like:

“Met Daniel after the investor breakfast. He moved to Google Cloud, his son Michael just turned one, and I should follow up next month.”

Intriq helps turn that into structured relationship memory, including people, facts, reminders, timelines, and searchable context.

What Intriq helps you do

Capture naturally
Write notes the way you think. No rigid forms, no CRM-style data entry.

Remember people properly
Keep useful context about someone’s work, family, interests, preferences, introductions, and life updates.

Prepare before meetings
Quickly recall what you know before a coffee, call, pitch, interview, or catch-up.

Follow up thoughtfully
Create reminders tied to people, not just generic tasks.

Search your relationship memory
Ask what you know about someone, find people by context, or recall recent updates.

Keep it private
Intriq is built for personal relationship memory, not public social posting.

Who Intriq is for

Intriq is useful for founders, business development professionals, investors, recruiters, consultants, operators, sales leaders, and anyone whose work depends on remembering people well.

A CRM manages pipeline.
Intriq helps you remember people.

Build stronger relationships by remembering what matters.
